axes.label: Drive
axes.description: Saturation/distortion intensity and compression hardness - how hard everything is being pushed.

axes.label: Brightness
axes.description: Overall EQ tilt - warm/rolled-off low end vs. present, cutting top end.

axes.label: Space
axes.description: Reverb/delay wetness - how much room and tail is built into the chain.

axes.label: Movement
axes.description: Chorus/phaser/tremolo/filter-sweep depth - how much the sound moves over time.

axes.label: Punch
axes.description: Transient/dynamic retention - punchy and dynamic vs. dense and compressed flat.

axes.label: Width
axes.description: Stereo image - mono/centered vs. wide stereo spread.

axes.label: Lo-Fi
axes.description: Textural degradation - pristine/full-bandwidth vs. bitcrushed/tape-noise/vinyl character.
